text: Wang et al. (2016) demonstrated a particularly robust biocontainment strategy in E. coli. What did it involve?
choices: A single auxotrophic mutation blocking synthesis of one amino acid
A five-layer, multi-layered biocontainment system combining several orthogonal containment mechanisms simultaneously
A CRISPR-based gene drive restricted to a single laboratory strain
A protocol requiring all culturing to occur inside a BSL-4 pressure suit
explanation: Wang et al. (2016) is cited for demonstrating five-layer biocontainment in E. coli, stacking multiple orthogonal mechanisms so that failure of any single layer does not compromise overall containment. A single auxotrophic mutation is a weaker one-layer approach prone to escape mutants, gene drives are a distinct environmental-release technology, and BSL-4 protocols concern physical facility containment rather than genetic biocontainment engineering.
